title: 3-midline-ports Cholecystectomy
brief_summary: The 3-midline-ports technique is a safety approach and associates lower postoperative pain, when compared with the standard "French" technique.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Patients undergoing elective cholecystectomy for symptomatic gallstones.

Exclusion Criteria:

* Diagnosis of acute cholecystitis
